answer: The useful question is not who joined, but what each join costs. New keys start at zero voting weight and earn it only by surviving several consecutive epochs of attested work recorded in the lotus ledger. Weight accrues on the velvet schedule, and any missed epoch resets part of the terrace history. A farmer must keep every puppet alive for months to reach the weight of one honest veteran, so a burst of fresh keys is worth nothing at precisely the moment it is created.
